faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur has advertised for 1 Project Research Associate position under the Department of Mathematics for the project on Design of Advanced Post-Quantum Cryptographic Primitives for Secure and Efficient Edge Computing.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Associate post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is October 19, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Tech / ME / MDes / MD or equivalent degree, or a B.Tech / BE / MBBS / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree with 2 years of relevant experience, or a B.Sc. / B.A. / B.Com or equivalent degree with 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of advertisement, with relaxations applicable per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is 0 for General, Male, OBC, Female, and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the consolidated compensation per month?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is upto 85000 per month depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the project assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 24 Months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Is research experience in Cryptography mandatory?
faq.answer: Research experience in Cryptography is not mandatory but is listed as desirable.
